technical-summary: The eight Qwen 3.8 27B TP3 serving configs carry the weight width in their names (q8, q6bc for BigCherry's 6-bit conversion). No aliases. The q6bc configs name the model file qwen3.8-27b-iq6r-v4-bc-df2-tp3.rad.
user-summary-candidate: Qwen 27B three-card config names now show the weight width: qwen27b-tp3 is qwen27b-tp3-q8, qwen27b-tp3-iq6r is qwen27b-tp3-q6bc. Saved launches must use the new names, and the 6-bit model file must be renamed to match.
